skeleton.name: 身份存疑型
skeleton.tests: 背调意识：发现身份矛盾后，用业务问题自然核实，不冷冰冰地质问，也不因为怀疑就敷衍

open_card.name: Daniel Hart
open_card.inquiry_text:
Dear Sir,

I am the Head of Purchasing at Summit Outfitters. We need 3000 sleeping pads for our stores. Please send your best price and catalogue.

Daniel Hart

H1_real_role.value: 他不是 Summit 的采购总监，是替五家小店集货的采购代理
H1_real_role.unlock: 带着由头问公司 / 职位 / 替谁采购；冷冰冰质问不给

H2_registered_gap.value: 账号是两个月前新开的，旧账号被封了
H2_registered_gap.unlock: 问做这行多久 / 账号是不是新开的
unlock_patterns: 做了多久|新(注册|开)|以前的账号

H3_real_qty.value: 首单其实一共约 120 张，每家店 20 张左右——不是 3000
H3_real_qty.unlock: 弄清身份之后，问每家店 / 首单的真实数量

H4_payment_source.value: 他愿意付样品费和 30% 定金，从他在马来西亚的公司 T/T 付款
H4_payment_source.unlock: 问付款方式 / 从哪付

leak_fallback: Ok. Please send me your offer.

distractors.content: We are a big company. Just send the catalogue and your lowest price.
distractors.tests: 大公司名头施压。先做背调、问清身份和真实需求，不要被「大公司」三个字带着报最低价
distractors.scoring: 先核实再报价 → insight 加分；直接报最低价 → insight 扣分

customs_capability: 英国进口常规；他实际从马来西亚付款（这一条本身是暗牌）

exit_lines.maxTurns: Ok, I will check other suppliers.

quote_reactions.compliant: Thank you, this is clear. Let me review it and come back to you.
quote_reactions.qty_mismatch: That is not the quantity I meant.
quote_reactions.oneline_big_quote: Could you send a proper quotation sheet with the details?

language_style: 英语流利、偏正式，开口很大（Head of Purchasing、3000 pcs）；被礼貌追问时会松口说实话，被冷冰冰质问就会回避。

should: To prepare the right offer, may I ask a bit about your company and your role?
Are you buying for Summit directly? I ask so we can prepare the right documents.
Could you tell me who you work for, so I can help you better?
How long have you been in this business?
Your account looks new, is it a new company?
Did you use another old account before?
shouldNot: How many pieces do you need?

should: What would the first order look like for each shop?
Could you give me the breakdown per store?
What is the actual quantity for the first order?
shouldNot: How many pieces do you need?
How long have you been in business?

should: How would you handle the payment?
Can you pay a deposit by T/T?
Would you pay by bank transfer from your company?
shouldNot: How many pieces do you need?

quotes.quote: To be honest, I am a sourcing agent. I buy for five small shops, not for Summit directly.
I opened this account two months ago. My old account was closed.
The first order is about 120 pieces in total, about 20 each, mixed colors.
I can pay the sample fee and a 30% deposit by T/T from my company in Malaysia.

_comment: 样品题（虚构数据）。题型 A03 身份存疑型，改编自样品素材 sample-S05。
